note: Operated by Price County (not Rusk County), near Kennan on the South Fork of the Jump River at Big Falls. The six sites line the surfaced camp road in pine woods about 100 m from the river, with a hiking trail along the falls. The open-air shelter is reserved separately. --Claude
summary: Price County facility page and the 2024 park map read: $20, 6 FCFS no-electric sites, open year-round (roads unplowed in winter), vault toilets + hand pump confirmed. Not waterfront confirmed (sites ~100 m from the river in forest). Pin ~350 m off; phone added.
flags: PHONE: stored null -> 715-339-6371 (the 'Contact' number on the Price County facility page).

PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 45.4052,-90.6361 is on the camp road near the park entrance junction north of the picnic area. Sites 1-6 line the camp road SE of the picnic area (map PDF); on imagery that road segment centres at about 45.4025,-90.6337 (~350 m SE). Suggest 45.4025,-90.6337 (sites under canopy; placed from the map on the visible road).
WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront confirmed. The camp road and sites run 95-110 m NE of the South Fork Jump River through continuous pine/hardwood forest; no open ground to the water.
FIT: the county page says only 'Surfaced road and parking area'; the 40-ft figure in inclusion_evidence comes from Travel Wisconsin, not the county. No length posted by the county.
